other_conditions: The applicant should have engaged in building and construction work for at least 90 days in a given year.
The applicant must be a registered member under the Building and Other Construction Workers Welfare Board of West Bengal.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹10,000 for hospitalization of 5+ days, up to ₹50,000 for accident‑related disablement, and a monthly pension of ₹750 (family pension ₹375) for permanently disabled workers.
